bypass_cache_on_refresh_desc.message: Predvolené nastavenie pre nové karty a naplánované pravidlá. Keď je zapnuté, obnovenia obídu vyrovnávaciu pamäť (zodpovedá Ctrl+Shift+R); keď je vypnuté, normálne načítanie použije zdroje z vyrovnávacej pamäte. Každá karta a pravidlo môže toto nastavenie prepísať vlastným režimom obnovenia.

recover_mode.description: Label for the per-tab/per-rule auto-recovery mode selector (popup and schedule modal).

recover_mode_default.description: Auto-recovery mode option: inherit the global setting.

auto_recover_enabled.description: General-tab checkbox label that enables auto-recovery globally.

auto_recover_desc.message: Automaticky znova načíta monitorovanú kartu, ktorej stránka sa nenačítala (žiadne pripojenie, chyba DNS, vypršanie času) alebo zostala visieť pri načítavaní. Pokusy opakuje podľa rastúceho rozvrhu (po približne 30 s, potom po 1, 2, 5, 10 a 30 min) a následne každých 30 minút, kým sa stránka nenačíta alebo to nevypnete. Vyžaduje jednorazové povolenie a funguje len na monitorovaných kartách. K dispozícii sú výnimky pre jednotlivé karty aj pravidlá.
auto_recover_desc.description: Description of the auto-recovery setting on the General tab.

recover_permission_denied.message: Automatické zotavenie potrebuje ďalšie povolenie, ktoré nebolo udelené.
recover_permission_denied.description: Toast/status shown when the user declines the webNavigation permission required for auto-recovery.

recover_perm_dialog_title.description: Title of the dialog shown before requesting the webNavigation permission for auto-recovery.

recover_perm_dialog_body.message: Aby rozšírenie zistilo, kedy sa sledovaná karta nenačíta, potrebuje povolenie prehliadača „webNavigation“. Chrome ho zobrazuje ako „Čítať históriu prehliadania“, no rozšírenie ho používa len na rozpoznanie neúspešných načítaní stránok a obsah vašich stránok stále čítať nedokáže. Kliknutím na Zapnúť ho udelíte.
recover_perm_dialog_body.description: Body text of the dialog explaining the webNavigation permission before the browser prompt.

pause_while_active_enabled.description: General-tab checkbox label for the smart-pause setting (skip a refresh while the user is active).

pause_while_active_desc.message: Keď aktívne používate kartu, ktorú si prezeráte (píšete alebo pohybujete myšou), naplánované znovunačítanie tejto karty sa preskočí a skúsi sa znova v ďalšom intervale, takže automatické obnovenie nikdy nepreruší vašu prácu. Využíva stav nečinnosti prehliadača a vzťahuje sa len na aktívnu kartu — karty na pozadí sa naďalej obnovujú podľa plánu.
pause_while_active_desc.description: Description of the smart-pause setting on the General tab.

resume.description: Resume menu item / button (resume a paused auto-refresh timer)

overlapping_schedule_url.message: Táto adresa URL sa prekrýva s existujúcim pravidlom plánu ({url}). Upravte vzor, aby ste predišli duplicitným obnoveniam.
overlapping_schedule_url.description: Error shown when a new or edited schedule rule would refresh the same page(s) as an existing rule.

invalid_schedule_url.message: Zadajte platnú adresu webu, napríklad example.com alebo https://example.com/page.
invalid_schedule_url.description: Error shown when a schedule rule's URL is not a valid website address.

command_toggle_refresh.message: Spustiť alebo zastaviť automatické obnovovanie na aktuálnej karte
command_toggle_refresh.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts for the command that starts or stops auto-refresh on the current tab.

command_toggle_pause.message: Pozastaviť alebo obnoviť automatické obnovovanie na aktuálnej karte
command_toggle_pause.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts for the command that pauses or resumes auto-refresh on the current tab.

bulk_heading.description: Popup heading for the section that starts/stops auto-refresh on every tab of the current window.

bulk_start_window.description: Popup button that starts auto-refresh on every refreshable tab of the current window.

bulk_stop_window.description: Popup button that stops auto-refresh on every refreshable tab of the current window.

bulk_result.description: Popup summary after a bulk start: how many tabs were started out of the total. {started} and {total} are numbers.

bulk_result_stop.description: Popup summary after a bulk stop: how many tabs were stopped out of the total. {stopped} and {total} are numbers.

bulk_skipped.description: Popup fragment appended to a bulk result: how many tabs were skipped (not refreshable). {skipped} is a number.

bulk_failed.description: Popup fragment appended to a bulk result: how many tabs failed. {failed} is a number.

bulk_capped.description: Popup fragment appended to a bulk result: how many tabs were not started because the active-timer limit was reached. {capped} is a number.

bulk_none_eligible.description: Popup message when a bulk action found no eligible (refreshable) tabs to act on.

bulk_error.description: Popup prefix shown when a bulk action failed to reach the background service worker.

command_bulk_window.message: Spustiť alebo zastaviť automatické obnovovanie na všetkých kartách okna
command_bulk_window.description: Keyboard shortcut description on chrome://extensions/shortcuts for the command that starts/stops auto-refresh on all tabs in the current window.

bulk_group_button.description: Popup button that starts/stops auto-refresh on every tab in the active tab's tab group. Shown only when the active tab is in a group.

bulk_group_none.message: Táto karta nie je v skupine
bulk_group_none.description: Popup message shown when a group bulk action was invoked on a tab that is not in any tab group.

command_bulk_group.message: Spustiť alebo zastaviť automatické obnovovanie na všetkých kartách skupiny
command_bulk_group.description: Keyboard shortcut description on chrome://extensions/shortcuts for the command that starts/stops auto-refresh on all tabs in the active tab's group.

interval_range.description: Popup heading for the section that starts auto-refresh with a random interval that varies between a minimum and a maximum.

interval_range_min.description: Placeholder for the minimum-seconds input of the random interval range.

interval_range_max.description: Placeholder for the maximum-seconds input of the random interval range.

interval_range_invalid.message: Zadajte platný rozsah: 30 až 86400 sekúnd, min nie väčšie ako max
interval_range_invalid.description: Popup error shown when the entered random interval range is invalid (not whole numbers, out of the 30s..24h range, or min greater than max).

set_range.description: Popup button that starts auto-refresh using the entered random interval range.

shortcuts_heading.description: Heading of the settings-page card that lists the extension's keyboard shortcuts.

shortcuts_customize.description: Label of the button that opens Chrome's shortcut-customization page.

shortcuts_not_set.description: Shown instead of a key combination when a command has no shortcut assigned.

shortcuts_hint.message: Skratky zmeníte alebo pridáte na stránke skratiek prehliadača Chrome.
shortcuts_hint.description: Hint under the shortcuts list telling the user where to change or add shortcuts.

refreshes_and_rules.description: Label of the merged settings tab that holds scheduled refreshes and URL rules.

popup_advanced.description: Label of the collapsible "Advanced" section in the popup that holds the interval range and the per-tab options.
